svg.aria-label: Sejohn Uruthiralingam: the future walks, learns, heals and builds. Humanoids, robot learning, medical robotics and autonomous machines. The ETHRC 26-DoF humanoid walks on a grid floor.

g.text: I enjoy the process of expanding my knowledge, challenging my own
thinking and turning ambitious ideas into real systems. My journey
has taken me from medical devices to humanoids and large-scale
autonomous machines, always driven by curiosity and the desire to
build technology that can make a real impact.
“Don't lose heart at a hard task; effort itself makes it possible.”
